output:
Hey Hollins Family Ties ❤️

Yes, I’m coming to Thanksgiving! I’ll see y’all Thursday, November 26, at Aunt Denise’s in Macon. We’re eating around 3, and I’m bringing the mac and cheese and two sweet potato pies.

I know some of y’all have been asking Mom if I’d be there, and I figure last year might have something to do with that. For the cousins who weren’t there, things got heated at the table over my job. I made a crack about somebody getting their news from a gas station TV. That was me, and I’m sorry for how I talked at Grandma’s holiday. Grandma ended up sitting out on the porch for about an hour, and I still feel bad about that.

I’m not sorry for the work I do, though. I’m proud of it. And just so we can save ourselves some time, I can’t talk about open cases because of confidentiality, so questions about “the lawsuit” are going to be a dead end anyway.

There’s no need for anybody to pick sides. The person I was arguing with isn’t a bad guy—he just likes to poke. He sent me a thumbs-up for my birthday in August, which for him is basically a hug, so I think we’re all right.

Can we call a truce on work and politics for one day? Let’s keep the table conversation to food, football, babies, and Tasha’s new boyfriend. Tasha, tell him I’m sorry in advance 😂

I really do want to be there, and I want it to be a good day for everybody, especially Grandma. Love y’all. See you in Macon!
